Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The kitchen table looked quieter than usual that evening. Max always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Also, his shoes were covered in mud.
Little by little, things began to change. Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. The cheese straws are dangerously moreish.

Nina will take part in a badminton match in April. The tea house has become an important part of daily life. Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The cake is topped with red cherries.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Nina keeps a small rabbit at home and feeds it every morning. The soup is too salty for me.
Max and Nina are preparing a report about the kitchen table. On Wednesday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. The experience taught Nina more than any book could.
